verses.text: While Israel was staying at Shittim, the men began to have sexual relations with Moabite women.
These women invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. The people ate the sacrifices and bowed down to these gods.
So Israel joined in worshipping Baal of Peor, and the LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of the people and kill them, and hang them up in broad daylight before the LORD, so that the LORD's fierce anger will turn away from Israel."
So Moses said to the judges of Israel, "Each of you must kill those of your men who have joined in worshipping Baal of Peor."
Just then, while Moses and the whole community of Israel were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting, an Israelite man brought a Midianite woman into his family's tent, right in front of them.
When Phinehas, son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest, saw this, he got up from the crowd and took a spear in his hand.
He followed the Israelite man into the tent and drove the spear through both of them, through the man and into the woman's body. Then the deadly disease among the people of Israel stopped.
But twenty-four thousand people had already died from the disease.

"Phinehas, son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest, has turned my anger away from the people of Israel. He was as eager as I am to protect my honour among them, so I did not destroy the people of Israel in my anger.
So tell him that I am making my covenant of peace with him.

It will be a covenant for him and his descendants after him, that they will be priests forever. This is because he was eager to protect the honour of his God, and he made the people of Israel right with God."
The Israelite man who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a family group in the tribe of Simeon.
The Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi, daughter of Zur, who was the head of a family group in Midian.
"Treat the Midianites as enemies and attack them.

They treated you as enemies when they tricked you into worshipping Baal of Peor, and through Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, their relative, who was killed on the day of the disease that came because of Peor."
